data.narrative:
New Limit is a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Brian Armstrong, Blake Byers, and Jacob Kimmel, with $610M+ raised to date and a current post-money valuation of $3.1B. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of 3 public biotech firms (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M).

Two valuation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $5.3B. Peer-median triangulation across same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables produced $3.8B, with the 3-peer sample ranging from $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring proved inapplicable due to absence of revenue disclosure. These two methods produced a low-to-high range of $3.2B to $6.1B, with a median of $4.5B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $3.2B–$6.1B, centered at $4.5B. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among peer valuations (reflecting stage and strategic heterogeneity within early-stage biotech) and the target's undisclosed revenue, which prevents revenue-multiple validation against public comparables.
